intro: Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan has studied the silithid and likens them to bees, with the queen as the weak point. A lure must draw her out, and it calls for a scent gland and soil from Un'Goro Crater, to the west.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My research revealed to me that the silithid are like bees; destroy the queen of the hive, and the rest of should be thrown into disarray. I'll brew a lure that we'll use to bring out the queen; once summoned, you'll take her down.

First though, we need some reagents; we don't want you bungling into the jungle unprepared. Go west to find the silithid hive in Un'Goro Crater and obtain a scent gland from one of the bugs. I'll also need some samples of the native Un'Goro soil.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Finding a suitable scent gland might take a bit - the gland can't be damaged, but the process of getting one certainly doesn't lend itself to it. As for the soil, I'd assume it should be easy enough to find.
Anyway, do you have the items I need to make the lure?

clips.title: Completion
paras: The scent gland, ah yes. The membrane appears intact - excellent. The soil, yes, this should work out perfectly. With my special additions, I should be able to grind all this up into the perfect lure.
Give me a moment to make the lure, friend. Once it's ready, we'll be able to enact the next step that may hopefully stop the silithid before they overrun Gadgetzan... And the rest of Kalimdor.
